title: Wonderworker
html_source:
An advertisement in Bloom’s desk drawer inventoried in the last chapter.

“1 prospectus of The Wonderworker, the world’s greatest remedy for rectal complaints, direct from Wonderworker, Coventry House, South Place, London E C, addressed (erroneously) to Mrs L. Bloom with brief accompanying note commencing (erroneously): Dear Madam.”

It’s not known if this is a real product (Gifford & Seidmann).
